purpose: Acknowledge a fact before adding a qualification.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Plain clause + とはいえ; sentence + とはいえ
Although it is spring, mornings are still cold.
Although it is finished, it still needs checking.
It is convenient. Even so, it is expensive.
formation: Plain clause + とはいえ; sentence + とはいえ
restrictions: The second clause limits what follows from the first.
mistake: It does not necessarily deny that the first fact is true.
